verification: Every sound's license was read from its Freesound source page rather than from search results. Each original's SHA-256 is recorded as downloaded. Note that audible-edge's tire squeals are also mirrored on OpenGameArt under CC-BY 3.0; the Freesound originals used here are the author's own CC0 release, which is why they are admissible under this policy.
conversion: Decoded with FFmpeg to mono 44100 Hz signed 16-bit PCM WAV, then excerpted. This departs from the sibling door and creature banks, which apply no content processing: the full originals total 388 MB (one is 11 minutes) and bundling them whole was not reasonable. Every excerpt's in/out point is recorded below against the original's SHA-256, so each cut is auditable. No processing beyond the decode and the trim was applied.
originals: Full unedited originals were retained outside the runtime package during source preparation; the hashes below identify them exactly.
sign_off: Every bundled excerpt was auditioned and approved by ear on 2026-07-15, as was every rejection recorded above.

excluded.name: Rubber Skid
excluded.author: shatterstars
excluded.reason: CC0 and admissible, but rejected by ear: it reads as someone sliding on glass rather than a car. Its original is also a lossy mp3 rather than a lossless master.

excluded.name: Car tire squeal skid loop / Car Tire Skid Squealing / Stunt Rally sounds
excluded.reason: The obvious OpenGameArt tire candidates are CC-BY 3.0 and CC-BY-SA, which this policy does not admit. Sourced the CC0 Freesound equivalents instead.

excluded.name: Mud Splat
excluded.author: Breviceps
excluded.reason: CC0 and admissible, but dropped: its siblings in the same pack are titled Cartoon Splat, and craigsmith's wheels-spinning recording covers mud with a real car instead.

excluded.name: SFX_stone_pebble_gravel / wet splat squish 01
excluded.reason: CC0 and admissible; rejected by ear while sourcing spray Foley.

excluded.name: MudSquelch and other mud-underfoot recordings
excluded.reason: Rejected for vehicles on physics, not quality: a foot in mud is suction -- weight pressing down and releasing -- where a tire throws mud outward. Kept only as an excluded lead for the footsteps domain.

collections.name: Car Driving Interior
collections.author: squareal
collections.caveat: Interior perspective: carries cabin tone as well as engine. Engine is audible in this recording. car_engine_generator owns the engine layer, so a renderer using this must expect to fight it or high-pass it out.

collections.name: S07-20 car stuck in mud; medium distance engine revs; wheels spin
collections.author: craigsmith
collections.caveat: The only recording in CC0 of a tire actually throwing mud: searches for car mud spray and tire mud return nothing at all. Engine bleed is the heaviest in this bank -- the title says medium distance engine revs -- and it was signed off by ear on that basis.
